criterion: Upload stores the original bytes on the volume with a SHA-256 in the database, and download streams identical bytes
Only PDF, JPEG, PNG and HEIC up to 20 MB are accepted, checked by content not extension
Documents are scoped to the organisation: another organisation or non-member cannot list or read them, and the file is only served through /api/v1
A linked document (retain_until set) rejects any update and any delete before its retention date; content columns are immutable always
Storage sits behind one interface (put, get)
